text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the Japan Cup over, there's about one month left until the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road and her three classmates
had gathered in a corner of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan,
could you tell me the rest of that story?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What kind of race will you make the Arima Kinen?
I want to know what you're thinking, Opera O-chan.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, then I shall unveil it.
My grand plan.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, my theme for the
Arima Kinen is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's the “Great Generational Showdown”!
Our generation versus the Golden Generation, that is.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Intergenerational... showdown...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're saying... you want to
compete with Special Week
and Grass Wonder?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, perhaps inspired by us,
it seems they're all planning to show up
in full force for the year-end Grand Prix."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"My original prediction was... that I would be
the only one facing them."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Assuming our generation becomes an era ruled solely
by the Century's End Overlord, that is. But—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"It didn't turn out that way.
Right now, Top Road-san is by my side, Doto is here, and so is Ayabe-san."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I think this in itself makes for a wonderful lineup.
It's not that I fell behind,
but that everyone rose to this level."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And precisely because we competed against each other,
we became the Dream Generation, every bit the equal of the Golden Generation."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Dream Generation...
It truly is, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've been hearing rumors lately.
People are saying our generation might be just as bumper a crop as the Golden Generation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Right? Since we've come this far,
don't you wanna try taking on the Golden Generation?
And then—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The winner will become a symbol that transcends generations!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The one who reaches the top shows the "path" as the ideal Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The... "path"?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Because the strongest Umamusume is, in essence, a guiding light herself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will proudly show them 'how an Uma Musume should be.'
To the audience, and to all Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fwehhh...
To all Umamusume, you say~?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You really hyped things up, didn't you?
Very typical of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A showdown between generations. There was certainly a rivalry against the Golden Generation burning within me. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it means showing the path to all Umamusume, the significance
is even greater. The value of victory changes as well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, speak of your dreams. If you were to win,
what path would you forge for the world?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall demonstrate the path of supreme rule!
The steep yet unyielding royal road!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I~... can't really say anything grand
about a path or purpose, but, well~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Maybe something like "the path of never giving up"?
Because I didn't give up,
I'm able to run like this today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. If it's something to say to the juniors,
I do have a few words. As for me..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "I want to show them a "path of stars." To show that even if you stray from your destiny, your path can still go on."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Everyone looks wonderful.
Then I'll—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I... I, of course...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now that you ask, nothing comes to mind.
Did anything happen with me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha!
Quite an amusing ad-lib you pulled off there.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
From my perspective, it's rare to find an Umamusume
who possesses as much as you do,
Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that so...?
Trainer, my path is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly put on the spot, I think it over.
The first thing that springs to mind is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Effort! Yes, exactly. A path forged by
steadily pressing on toward the pinnacle!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That does sound very much like me.
In that case, I shall use the Arima Kinen to demonstrate the path forged by hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Things are really heating up, aren't they?
A clash of generations, and winning it...
to pave the way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let's all do our best together, so we won't lose to the Golden Generation!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Yes.
Right on~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Narita Top Road's rallying cry,
everyone united as one.
And so, our resolve for the Arima Kinen was set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that night—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The path of hard work... Thank you
for the wonderful idea, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will do it!
I'll definitely make everyone understand the beauty of striving toward the summit!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? You've gone quiet...
Did I say something strange?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I think about the word "effort." Narita Top Road is undeniably a paragon of hard work. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that 'hard work' alone doesn't quite cover it.
In other words...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's only a part of Narita Top Road.
I feel like it doesn't quite capture her "essence."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just what kind of Umamusume—is she?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, is something the matter?
You're staring right at my face..."
choice_data_list: No, let's think about this a little more.
No, let's think about it a little more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Think about it... as in, about the path ahead?
choice_data_list: Yeah, there might be a more fitting one.
Yeah, maybe there's something more suitable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Understood! Although, I do quite like the path of hard work and effort...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I hope to think about it before the big day.
The path I've walked with you, Trainer, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: About the path we will continue to walk forward together!
